_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P0 operational targets.

requirements.title: One-action launch
requirements.description: Choose topics, allowance and emphasis and receive a complete packet (charter, stance message, goal kernel) with size gates, launched into a Web Console Codex session automatically or shown as two messages to paste.

validation.notes: packet.py gates (charter bytes, stance, kernel) on a prepared packet
automatic launch types the stance and kernel and records each step in LAUNCH.json
the two messages to paste are a read (GetLaunchMessages) and write nothing
a failed gate refuses before any session exists
one automatic launch into a throwaway Web Console session (docs/internal/evidence/launch-proof.txt)

requirements.title: Clean-start verdict
requirements.description: Before launch, state per selected topic whether an earlier commission touches it, its observed state (live, paused, limited, stopped, ended, prepared, unknown), and what this launch does about it; refuse to double-supervise a live topic unless the operator explicitly runs alongside.

validation.notes: only an open commission blocks; supersede or run alongside resolves it in the request
prepared only with proof nothing started it
overlapping commissions per topic

requirements.title: Discard and relaunch
requirements.description: A bad start is stopped (never deleted), verified inactive, marked discarded with the operator's reason, and relaunched as a new commission rebuilt from the same packet inputs, superseding the old one.

validation.notes: stop never deletes the session
relaunch is a new commission from the same inputs
discard and relaunch through packet.py

requirements.title: Activity projection
requirements.description: Show active research, last activity per topic, running supervisors, the topics each supervises and commissions overlapping in time, derived only from research-home files and harness session records, with unknown where a value cannot be derived.

validation.notes: every derived value has a source or is unknown
state from Codex session records
last activity per run folder
an unreadable file is unknown, never empty

Re-run with `make real-home-check` on the machine that holds the research home; it reads the home only, and fails when the home is absent (REAL_HOME_CHECK_SKIP=1 skips it, loudly). docs/internal/evidence/real-home-check.txt is one frozen run from 2026-11-12, not a live result.

requirements.title: File-only steering
requirements.description: Operator direction is appended verbatim to a desk-owned operator file the supervisor already re-reads at unit start; nothing is sent into a supervisor conversation.

validation.notes: entries appended verbatim to OPERATOR.md
4,000-character entries
say and enable steering

requirements.title: Decision courier
requirements.description: Needs-you items written by supervisors become one feed, are delivered to Notification Hub as decisions, and answers are read back from the Hub into the operator file, so a desk or webhook outage loses no answer; the UI answers directly when the Hub is down.

validation.notes: ask raised and answer read back into OPERATOR.md
old items are never sent
nothing delivered while answers cannot be read
the desk answers directly

requirements.title: Focus measurement
requirements.description: Measure and display each supervisor and owner role's read set, as listed in the research-coordination skill's limits.json, in bytes and estimated tokens, and flag sets over their ceilings, an oversized charter and appended amendments.

validation.notes: read sets measured from limits.json with flags
no-growth: role totals within ceilings

requirements.title: Review support
requirements.description: A research-review skill and desk support for an operator review session over selected topics: evidence of accomplishment, tidy-up proposals, verdicts recorded verbatim and missions realigned only by explicit operator action.

validation.notes: review topics, proposals and verbatim verdicts; MISSION.md untouched

requirements.title: Scenario-owned research skills
requirements.description: Research skills move into scenarios/research-desk/skills through the supported ownership route with prompt-manager skill read and the direct-file fallback still working, and the supervisor procedure gains written route discipline for failing optional routes.

validation.notes: the five skills live in this scenario; the rendered charter carries route discipline and the needs-you decision line
packet.py renders the contract lines, holds skill files to their ceilings, and the three needs-you grammar copies agree
prompt-manager skill-set validation of research-desk passes
with the desk stopped, all five skills read through prompt-manager and by path, and packet.py and mission_check.py ran (2026-11-12)

requirements.title: Detached by construction
requirements.description: Stopping the desk mid-commission changes nothing for supervisors or owners; every packet launches by hand from its folder; commissions launched by hand are recognised.

validation.notes: only the live instance writes
a desk stop mid-launch is recorded, nothing else changes
hand-launched and desk-launched commissions are recognised

requirements.title: Phone-first interface
requirements.description: API and CLI first, then a UI designed for phone width on the tunnel hostname that replaces the generated placeholder completely.

validation.notes: the phone UI's outward flows: Needs you, commission controls and steering, review verdicts and launch, each through its confirmation
the served UI renders its pages without runtime errors

requirements.title: Control without chat
requirements.description: Pause, resume, wind down, stop and discard a commission from the desk without writing a message in its conversation; wind down is an operator-file entry, the others act on the session only on an operator tap and are recorded.

validation.notes: pause, resume and stop act only on an open window and are recorded
controls reach only the commission's own thread
wind down is an operator-file entry

requirements.title: Since last look
requirements.description: Per commission and per topic, show what changed since the operator last looked: new ledger text, changed checkpoints, showcase lines and workstream status changes.

validation.notes: changes since the recorded look or --since
ledger text, checkpoints, showcase lines and statuses
